name: Acadia Mountain Guides Adventure Day Camps
description_short: Week long outdoor adventure day camps in Acadia National Park run by a climbing school. Mountain Monkeys (ages 6 to 9) and Young Explorers (ages 9 to 13) climb, rappel, hike Acadia's peaks, swim and canoe in small guided groups, with drop off in Bar Harbor, Ellsworth or Bangor.
notes: Small groups of 4 to 10. Drop off and pick up at the Bar Harbor shop (9:30 am to 3:30 pm), Ellsworth (8:45 am to 4:30 pm) or Alpenglow Adventure Sports, 753 Stillwater Ave, Bangor (7:30 am to 5:30 pm). Young Explorers is listed 'from $350'. The same school runs overnight teen climbing camps (RockPro series, multisport), not included here.
